newsitem.title: USA: Spectrian files to register 2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Spectrian files to register 2 mln shares.

text.p: Spectrian Corp filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to two million common shares
Underwriters for the offering, Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, Lehman Brothers and Oppenheimer & Co Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 300,000 shares.
Spectrian, a maker of radio frequency power amplifiers, said proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes and capital expenditures.
After the offering, the company will have 10,357,157 shares outstanding.
